text:
Type: trellis patterned flatwoven rug
Use: anchoring a seating or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: classic, contemporary, traditional
Materials: flatwoven wool-like yarn
Colors: dark chocolate brown, cream
Shape: rectangular, flat, allover cream ogee lattice of curved interlocking lines on a solid brown ground, clean edges, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, elegant, cozy, balanced
Goes with: cream or beige sofas, warm wood, brass, leather; classic, transitional or contemporary rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: Handwoven by skilled craftspeople, each one is unique. Made in India in organised weaving centres with good working conditions and fair wages.
